items.author: Lenin's last cat
items.text:
Great tool, and thanks for keeping it read-only and open about what it sends. I maintain a private CK3 tooling suite for a large modded playset, and parts of it could complement Mod Doctor:

- Pure-Python minidump parsing: exception code, faulting module + module-relative offset (stable across runs), crash thread and stack shape, so "same crash as before" is reliable.
- Override-resolved conflict detection: which mod wins each script key, including keys a later mod removes by replacing a file.
- Portrait DNA tools: decode and validate save DNA against the genes your mod list defines (useful for "missing gene" crashes).
- Boot-time profiling per load stage and database.

If any of that interests you, I'm happy to package it and send it over. Just reply here.
